slides.text: A bigger CPU number is always faster

posts.title: Back up your files the easy way

slides.text:
Back up your files the easy way
Plug in a USB drive or external SSD
Plug in a USB drive or external SSD
Settings > System > Storage > Advanced > Backup options
Turn on File History — it keeps versioned copies
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Back up your files the easy way 🛠️

1. Plug in a USB drive or external SSD
2. Settings > System > Storage > Advanced > Backup options
3. Turn on File History
     ✓ it keeps versioned copies
